scope: Unlabeled application of the frozen correspondence model to camera-generated marker positions
presentations: Both DAGE and DA3; all twelve existing image tracks per clip; fit only frames 1..10; source frame 1; fixed queries 30,60,89. Exactly 216 planned presentations. Missing fits and invalid projections remain recorded, not converted into failures. Never use later tracked coordinates to generate candidate markers.
arms: Frozen Qwen2.5-VL-3B base with adapter disabled and the previously fixed twenty-pass correspondence adapter. Identical images and original correspondence prompt; no new training, no checkpoint selection, no calibration exports or images opened.
inference: Same NF4 and fp32 attention configuration used in the prior external correspondence comparison; greedy decoding, maximum eight new tokens, exact close/far/occluded/uncertain parser; invalid responses retained.
reporting: Report label counts and availability against all planned presentations. There are no human or reference correspondence labels for these panels. Do not calculate accuracy, declare camera superiority from label counts, or use the judge outputs as ground truth.
limitations: A single fitted 3D point is uncertain; camera, calibration, prefix identity, object motion, and point fitting can affect marker placement. Predicted correspondence labels are neither staticness nor functional DNF labels. This experiment connects the trained judge to the camera harness but cannot establish its validity by itself.
